object_description: raised and extended main building with a covered reception courtyard
design_condition: The intervention extends the existing main volume on the downstream side and raises it by two levels, reinforcing the entrance courtyard while preserving the dominant building, landscape setting and heritage presence.

positive.statement: The approach respects and strengthens the existing identity and the spatial, architectural and natural qualities of the site.
The compact intervention as an extension and raising of the main volume finds full meaning in the landscape context.
The covered reception space establishes a strong relationship between the main building and the gym.
The enlarged theater, new square and exterior extensions provide high-quality gathering and terrace spaces.
The distribution of functions is relevant, with the dining space correctly connected to the landscape, gym and aula.
The exceptional top floor combines a strong relationship with the sky and city with study rooms, a library and generous outdoor space.
The proposals promote the heritage witness and create a convincing dialogue with vegetation and nature.
The gym is very little affected by the intervention.

negative.statement: Raising the building by two levels will probably require strengthening the foundations.
The formalization of the new staircase, particularly its relationship to the elevators and light void, is unconvincing.
The two open stairwells do not function as escape routes.
Independent use of the dining space in connection with the gym outside school hours is difficult.
